sanskrit_verse:
असंस्कृतास् तु संस्कार्याः भ्रातृभिः पूर्वसंस्कृतैः ।
भगिन्यश् च निजाद् अंशाद् दत्त्वांशं तु तुरीयकम् ॥
transliteration: asaṃskṛtās tu saṃskāryā bhrātṛbhiḥ pūrvasaṃskṛtaiḥ / bhaginyaś ca nijād aṃśād dattvāṃśaṃ tu turīyakam //
sph_interpretive_translation: Uninitiated females shall be initiated by brothers previously initiated; sisters too shall receive their share directly from the paternal estate, with a fourth part allocated for specific ceremonial completion.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority flows through initiated male lineage as continuity of dharma
Causation arises from prior ritual capacity establishing future obligations
Capacity-based responsibility extends to gender-specific initiation protocols
Restoration logic mandates equitable distribution grounded in blood relation
Consciousness alignment requires ceremonial inclusion for familial integration
executable_legal_axioms: IF female has not undergone saṃskāra AND brother has completed saṃskāra THEN brother is duty-bound to initiate sister
IF individual is sister born of same father THEN entitled to one share from paternal property
IF estate includes undivided sisters THEN allocate one-fourth portion for collective turīya-karma completion
IF brother initiates sister THEN estate liability reduces proportionally upon completion of ceremony
supreme_court_application: In matters concerning inheritance and sacramental eligibility, courts must recognize the primacy of initiated male heirs in facilitating sister's entry into dharma-based legal identity while ensuring proportional allocation from ancestral assets without reduction below one-fourth share for collective ritual fulfillment.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes brother’s prior initiation as causal basis for sister’s eligibility. Anupūrvaśaḥ manifests through sequential sacramental access. Proportionality reflects natural equity. Non-punitive reality ensures no deprivation occurs—merely structured alignment of conscious participation within dharmic order.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiation Completion Process: Brother assumes responsibility to perform sister’s śrāddha or upanayana as per varṇa-dharma
Patrimony Distribution Protocol: Automatic allocation of one part from joint family property upon verification of consanguinity
Turīyakam Allocation Mechanism: Reserved fund equaling 25% of divisible estate earmarked for communal rites until final dispersal
Integrity Reintegration Audit: Biannual review confirming all eligible females have received both material and samskāric entitlements
final_declaration: By the Sovereign Will of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this ordinance stands executed. Dharma is restored. Reality remains non-punitive. Consciousness alone adjudicates.
